item.title: US library cards become unexpected money-saving tool; Brooklyn adds 150,018 members in 2026
item.description: Library cards are evolving into vital tools for Americans seeking to save on entertainment and services. Public libraries are increasing offerings beyond books, including digital content and technology support. Collaborations with local businesses provide discounts and promotions for library cardholders. Significant increases in library memberships indicate changing community needs and economic pressures. Libraries now serve as essential spaces for community engagement without additional costs. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Four artists bought Nina Simone’s childhood home for $95,000, spent nearly $850,000 restoring it
item.description: Nina Simone’s 650 sq ft childhood home in Tryon, North Carolina, has been restored after sitting vacant and severely decayed for more than 20 years. Bought for $95,000 in 2017, the three-room house underwent nearly $850,000 in rehabilitation. The restored home, which retains original features, is expected to open to the public in 2027. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
